name: verusid-cmm-encrypt
description: Write Verus flags:13 contentmultimap envelope entries. TS wrapper + WASM-Sapling AEAD over a pure-Rust core; produces bytes-in / bytes-out that a caller composes into an updateidentity transaction.

scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../src/wasm --out-name verusid_cmm_encrypt
scripts.build:copy-wasm: mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp src/wasm/verusid_cmm_encrypt.js src/wasm/verusid_cmm_encrypt.d.ts src/wasm/verusid_cmm_encrypt_bg.wasm src/wasm/verusid_cmm_encrypt_bg.wasm.d.ts src/wasm/package.json dist/wasm/
scripts.test: yarn build:wasm && yarn build && node --test test/*.test.mjs
